about_the_game:
Flesh and Spirit is a mythic action-adventure set in the antediluvian world — the forgotten age before the Great Cataclysm. You play as a chosen Guardian, a protector of the scattered remnants of humanity, facing off against the monstrous giants (Nephilim) and twisted creatures that roam a corrupted Earth.

As the world moves closer to the brink of annihilation, you must navigate a land steeped in ancient power, lost civilizations, and dark supernatural forces. The line between flesh and spirit is thin; your choices will determine not just your survival, but the destiny of those you are sworn to protect.

Explore vast, decaying landscapes inspired by ancient myths. Engage in brutal, skill-based combat against overwhelming foes. Uncover hidden knowledge that challenges everything you know about creation, rebellion, and sacrifice. In a time when humanity is caught between divine judgment and monstrous terror, will you hold onto the mortal world — or transcend it?

The end is near. Flesh withers. Spirit endures. Choose wisely.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Minimum specs are aimed at 1080p resolution, low-to-medium settings, 30+ FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Super or AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Currently not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1440p gaming, high settings, 60+ FPS.
